public_art.title: Torso with Raised Arm
public_art.location: Side of building, midblock, along Sacramento Street
public_art.art_requirement_note: Predates the 1985 Downtown Plan; the art was provided under approvals guided by the pending plan.
public_art.title_note: The city's inventory titles it “Torso with arm raised”.
public_art.detail: De Staebler's own curriculum vitae lists this bronze work at the Portman Building, Embarcadero Center West, dated 1990; another source dates an installation of the same title to 1987.

public_art.title: Baile Merengue
public_art.art_requirement_note: Predates the 1985 Downtown Plan; the art was provided under approvals guided by the pending plan.
public_art.detail: Bill Barrett (born December 21, 1934), an American sculptor, is the artist of this bronze work on view in the Embarcadero Center West lobby.
